metadata.summary: The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) is a comprehensive, multi-omics characterization of human cancers across 33 cancer types and more than 11,000 patients, combining genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic data with associated clinical and (for many cohorts) radiologic/pathology imaging via TCIA.
metadata.custodian: National Cancer Institute (NCI) and National Human Genome Research Institute
metadata.purpose: Molecular subtyping, biomarker discovery, and imaging-genomics research.

ethics.license: Open access with data use certification (mostly unrestricted)
ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification per HIPAA standards; controlled access for sensitive data via dbGaP.
ethics.legal_compliance: Compliant with U.S. Common Rule, HIPAA, and NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: geography.countries is heuristically inferred from limitation text; requires manual verification
The following LLM fields were auto-dropped for violating schema constraints and reverted to baseline; pending manual review: modality/modalities[list-items]

bias_and_limitations.modifications: No synthetic data; data harmonized across platforms with batch correction where possible.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: US-dominated enrollment; limited international and minority representation.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Findings may not generalize to non-US populations or underrepresented cancer subtypes.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Uneven coverage across ancestry groups, age groups, and cancer subtypes.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Missing clinical variables in some cohorts; missing imaging for many genomic cases.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Real-time clinical decision support; direct diagnostic use without validation.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Comprehensive, multi-omics characterization of human cancers across 33 cancer types.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Retrospective; US-led with international contributing sites.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Aggregates data from multiple institutions and platforms; includes cross-platform/batch heterogeneity.

population.target_population: Patients diagnosed with any of 33 cancer types.
population.inclusion_criteria: Diagnosis of one of 33 TCGA-defined cancer types.
population.missing_groups: Limited paired imaging-genomics cohorts; US-dominated enrollment; uneven subtype representation.

annotation.annotation_method: Expert curation of molecular and clinical annotations; pathology slide review by pathologists.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Clinical and molecular annotations derived from centralized biospecimen processing and expert review.
annotation.label_noise_description: Cross-platform/batch heterogeneity; uneven subtype representation; limited paired imaging-genomics cohorts.
